card.name: The Unhappy Maiden
card.effect: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, the Battle Phase for that turn ends immediately.

design: Mandatory trigger requires battle destruction, destination Graveyard, completed Damage Step, current turn, and the owner's physical team Graveyard.
Physical owner seat is derived from m0..m3 UID; the owner team may differ from the team whose Battle Phase is active.
The effect records a deferred end request; it never changes the phase while a Chain, trigger queue, Damage Step, or response window remains open.
After the chain settles, the adapter opens the engine's existing Battle-Phase-end response boundary, preserving normal End Phase cleanup and the six-card discard flow.
A source removed from the Graveyard after its trigger was activated still resolves; a negated trigger does not request the phase end.
Multiple activations coalesce, activation receipts are idempotent, and no card is created, moved, or granted by resolution.

rulesValidated.handDiscard: deferred to the existing engine End Phase

implementation.integrationBoundary: Isolated TagDuel adapter only. No central resolver, card catalog, command handler, or Discord runtime integration was changed; that work remains blocked on the explicit M61 handoff.

focusedScenarios: inactive physical owner and opposing active Battle Phase
reject non-battle sends, banishment, incomplete Damage Step, wrong owner team, wrong battle team, and stale turn
wait for Chain/trigger queue completion before requesting Battle Phase end
coalesce multiple Maidens into one phase-end request
already-ended Battle Phase is not ended twice
3+3 zones, Main Deck 20/30 boundaries, Extra Deck maximum five
hand size above six is not discarded by this adapter

limitations: The production adapter is pinned to passcode 51275027, but the card is not registered in the catalog/resolver on this branch.
The adapter requires the host to pass the actual battle-destroyed trigger event and call finalizeAfterChain after the engine's trigger/Chain queues settle.
Focused CI must pass before the adapter can be treated as verified; no local repository runtime was available in this session.
